messages:
Tara Benson: Follow-up from the PM: two regressions slipped past our rollout gates. We agreed to concrete remediation owners + short timelines. Putting notes here.
Ibrahim Kahn: I can own automated rollback rules. Plan: small rules engine, multi-signal evaluation (error %, p95, user-visible errors), call `pause-rollout` endpoint. Prototype by Thu EOD.
Riley Moore: I'll own flag metadata and blast-radius enforcement. Proposal: require `max_blast_radius` and `initial_fraction` on flag creation and surface warnings in the UI. I'll draft schema + lint.
Zoe Patel: I'll take telemetry and recurring-pattern ownership. Will add two scheduled detectors: a quick-canary-spike (10m) and a slow-drift aggregator (weekly). Backfill 45 days to improve baselines.
Tara Benson: Please post PRs into the rollout-guardrails repo and add links here. Also scheduling a 30m sync every week for 4 weeks.
safety-bot: Meeting created: "Rollout safety follow-ups" weekly Fri 09:00 for 4 occurrences.
Ibrahim Kahn: Implementation note: rollback actions should be idempotent and emit structured audit events. Avoid flipping flags directly. Use an RPC `pause-rollout(flag_id, reason)` so the UI can show state.
Riley Moore: Suggested default values: `max_blast_radius: 0.02`, `initial_fraction: 0.005`, ramp: [0.005, 0.02, 0.1, 1.0]. Will include a server-side check to prevent missing `max_blast_radius`.
Zoe Patel: Saved queries I'll add: `canary_spike_v1` (5x baseline within 10m) and `p95_regression_v1` (p95 +30% sustained). Alerts -> #eng-oncall + primary owner.
Tara Benson: Owner matrix: Ibrahim -> auto-rollback (proto Thu, tests Mon), Riley -> flag schema + UI (PR Fri), Zoe -> telemetry + dashboards (jobs Mon). I'll update postmortem with the matrix and link PRs.
Ibrahim Kahn: Draft PR for rollback engine: https://git.redwood/ri/guardrails/pulls/401 (WIP). Please review.
Riley Moore: Draft PR for flag schema + lint: https://git.redwood/ri/flags/pulls/143 (WIP). Added server-side validation.
Zoe Patel: Dashboards + queries posted to #eng-observability; pinging here once alerts wired.
Tara Benson: We also decided to rotate remediation ownership monthly to ensure recurring issues get steady attention. I'll add primary + backup fields in the runbook.
Ibrahim Kahn: One more: implement a soft-pause mode that reduces rollout rate to 0.1% before full pause so we can gather more signals. I'll include it in the prototype.
Riley Moore: I'll add a pre-creation lint in the CLI so CI will fail if `max_blast_radius` is omitted in flag PRs.
Zoe Patel: Backfill started — ingesting 45 days now. Will post histograms and baselines in the dashboard.
Tara Benson: Please react with :white_check_mark: once your first PR is merged to mark this action closed. Thanks everyone.
Ibrahim Kahn: Merged prototype branch to main in a feature toggle for testing.
Riley Moore: PR merged to flags schema branch; lint rule in place.
Zoe Patel: Dashboards live; alerts wired to #eng-oncall.
Tara Benson: Closing thread: tracking items into postmortem follow-up checklist and calendar invites created. If blockers pop up, ping me directly.
